decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix draws little on the firm's engineering and waste-conversion knowledge, so it has weak absorptive capacity to read early market signals or improve the product, which makes it the natural candidate to cut.
Modular waste-to-energy extensions build directly on the firm's core plant engineering and in-house prototyping, so it can interpret feedback and refine the models.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant is a flagship with its own page and sits squarely within the firm's accumulated conversion-technology expertise, giving it strong capacity to assimilate results and improve it.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is a strategic focus that shares the firm's thermochemical and engineering knowledge base, so its own R&D can carry it through early development.
